skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, principles, and models of corporate governance, and apply them effectively in business contexts.
Understand the role and structure of corporate boards and executive management.
Understand legal frameworks and compliance issues in corporate governance.
Understand the roles and interests of shareholders and stakeholders in corporate governance.
Understand risk management strategies and internal control mechanisms in corporate governance.
Understand global trends and models of corporate governance.
Understand the specific context and regulations of corporate governance in Vietnam.
Analyze and evaluate corporate governance issues and propose recommendations.
Effectively present and defend corporate governance concepts and solutions.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and discussions.
Conduct research and analyze data related to corporate governance.
